\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Parallel vector fields and reparametrization] 1. ch4:4-10

Suppose $M$ is a smooth manifold endowed with a connection, $\gamma : I \to M$ is a smooth curve, and $Y \in \mathfrak {X}(\gamma )$. Prove that if $Y$ is parallel along $\gamma $, then it is parallel along every reparametrization of $\gamma $. \end{exercise}
